title: Improvement work of Kanhoji Angre Island Lighthouse station and premises
summary: Two-cover percentage-rate e-tender for improvement works (jungle clearing, plaster repairs, painting, PU floor coating, GI chain-link fencing, steel gate and grating work, name boards, modular toilet, boat hire) at Kanhoji Angre Island Lighthouse, Khanderi Island, Raigad, Maharashtra.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, M.G. Road, Ghatkopar (East), Mumbai

sites.name: Kanhoji Angre Island Lighthouse Station, Khanderi Island, Raigad, Maharashtra
sites.work: Improvement work of lighthouse station and premises

scope.item: Clearing jungle incl. uprooting vegetation, grass, brush wood, trees and saplings up to 30 cm girth and removal of rubbish; rate 17.60, amount 92,488.00
Dismantling steel work in built up sections (angles, tees, flats, pipe, channels); rate 5.65, amount 1,073.50
Removing distemper/synthetic enamel/cement paint from wall surfaces by scraping and sand papering; rate 25.15, amount 1,131.75
Repair to plaster 12-20 mm in patches up to 2.5 sqm with white cement based polymer modified self curing mortar; rate 540.35, amount 2,32,350.50
Premium acrylic smooth exterior paint with silicone additives (Asian/Snowcem/Berger), old work, two or more coats @ 1.43 ltr/10 sqm; rate 108.60, amount 32,037.00
Synthetic enamel paint (Asian/Berger/Shalimar) in two or more coats over undercoat; rate 131.45, amount 53,894.50
Polyurethane (PU) floor paint (Asian/Indigo/Dulux) over old paver block internal pathway/road; rate 259.00, amount 1,76,120.00
Excavation in hard rock (blasting prohibited) in foundation trenches/drains; rate 1,523.05, amount 6,092.20
Cement concrete 1:4:8 (40 mm aggregate) in foundation and plinth; rate 6,812.00, amount 6,812.00
Brick work, class 7.5 FPS bricks in CM 1:4, foundation and plinth; rate 7,311.25, amount 21,933.75
Brick work, class 7.5 FPS bricks in CM 1:4, superstructure above plinth; rate 9,344.35, amount 28,033.05
Cement concrete 1:2:4 in coping incl. centering and shuttering; rate 9,895.20, amount 29,685.60
18 mm cement plaster in two coats (12 mm 1:5 + 6 mm 1:3) finished rough with sponge; rate 537.45, amount 91,366.50
Main gate with G.I. pipe 'C' class and M.S. flats/plates, 3.70 m x 2.00 m (drawing MUM/503/2025), incl. rails and synthetic enamel painting; rate 71,521.00
Steel work welded in built up sections/framed work in gratings, frames, brackets, gates (MS pipe C-class) incl. priming; rate 172.60, amount 3,84,898.00
G.I. chain link fabric fencing, 4 mm GI wire PVC coated to >= 5 mm, 50x50 mm mesh; rate 1,067.10, amount 5,54,892.00
Lighthouse/Department name board in black granite 90 x 120 cm with engraved golden letters in three languages (drawing B/3006); rate 19,348.00
Department emblem in granite plate 60 x 130 cm with engraved golden letters (drawing MUM82303/2022); rate 10,954.00
4-seater modular toilet with cubicles 915 x 915 x 1980 mm and 400 litre sludge tank; rate 1,60,000.00
Hire of load and passenger mechanised boats/pontoons for potable water (incl. pumping to storage tank), labour and materials from Thal jetty to Kanhoji Angre landing; rate 75,000.00
Labour for carriage of construction material from Kanhoji Angre landing to lighthouse premises and removal of debris at island; rate 50,000.00

money.performance_security: 5% of contract value (FDR or bank guarantee) before work order, released on completion; plus security deposit 5% deducted from each RA bill, released after 6 months defect liability period
money.notes: Estimated cost inclusive of GST (BoQ total Rs 20,99,631.35). EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships - Mumbai, valid three months from technical bid opening; mandatory for all including MSME/NSIC bidders; original by 14/10/2025 17:00. Labour cess 1% deducted from RA bills. Liquidated damages 0.5% per week up to 10%. Water/electricity if provided by department recovered at 1% each of tender cost. Quantities may vary +/-25%.

period.completion: 01 month from date of issue of work order
period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Registered licensed contractors/firms of appropriate category with Central Govt/State Govt/Municipal Corporation etc. having tender limits equal to or more than estimated cost

Similar works in last 7 years: three works >= 40% (Rs 8.40 lakh), or two >= 60% (Rs 12.59 lakh), or one >= 80% (Rs 16.79 lakh) of estimated cost; certificates from officer not below Executive Engineer; sub-contractor experience not considered
Similar works: civil construction, repair and maintenance work
Average annual turnover at least 30% of estimated cost (Rs 6,29,889) over last 3 financial years
PAN, GST registration, ITRs for 2021-22 to 2023-24, audited turnover/P&L statements
Annexures: tender acceptance letter, unconditional bid undertaking, bid securing declaration, non-blacklisting affidavit, no-relatives declaration, Make in India self-certification

Technical evaluation minimum 70/100: statutory requirements 30, financial standing 20, similar experience 20, performance of previous works 20, key technical personnel 10 (1 graduate civil engineer, 2 diploma civil engineers)
specs: Works per CPWD specifications volumes I-VI, electrical volumes I-III and horticulture; BIS codes
53 grade OPC/PPC/SRC cement from manufacturers with >= 1 million tonne/year capacity
Paint shades: snow/brilliant white for trestle/GI/RCC tower, signal red for trestle tower, bus green for automation box and hand rail, black for gate/pedestal
Site on island reachable only by boat from Thal (Alibag) or Gateway of India jetty
notes: Listing title is misspelt 'mprovement work of Kanhoji Angre Island Lighthouse station and premises'; cover page spells 'Isalnd'. Eligibility inconsistencies: Hindi NIT page and Section III say two similar works >= 60% while standard is 50%; turnover period stated as ending 31/03/2024 in 3.1.1 but 31/03/2025 in cover-1 list. Index page numbers do not match actual sections (BoQ and evaluation criteria both listed as pages 48-51). Section VII BoQ is included in the PDF (Section VIII annotation says uploaded separately). GCC (Section IV) is standard DGLL boilerplate; bank guarantee proforma dated 2025.
